EmailTemplate.name: Contact: Re-send Welcome Email
EmailTemplate.subject: Portal Login Issues
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
Hope you are doing well.
I have just re-sent our welcome email to help you set up your credentials and log into our portal. Please use the email address {!Contact.Email} and the new password you create.
If you have any questions or if the issue persists, please let us know.
Thank you,
{!EmailMessage.FromName}
